scope: Research for problem-class selection and failure-fallback study. External results are not AKS efficacy measurements and are not pooled with local trials.

sources.title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks
sources.use: Paired expertise-heavy task evaluation; heterogeneous gains, negative cases, focused modules and procedural content. Not an AKS or CLI-help-discovery study.

sources.title: SWE-Skills-Bench: Do Agent Skills Actually Help in Real-World Software Engineering?
sources.use: Limited aggregate benefit in a different task population; omitted-procedure improvements and template anchoring risk. Do not equate significance with proof of zero effect.

sources.title: Equipping agents for the real world with Agent Skills
sources.use: Startup metadata exposure, progressive disclosure and deterministic script bundles. Distinguish from this repository's unadvertised help-only CLI catalog.

sources.title: Understand how Azure Resource Manager throttles requests
sources.use: Response-layer classification, SDK retry caveat and Retry-After. The study injects synthetic 503s, not measured 429 rate limiting.

sources.title: Retry Storm antipattern
sources.use: Bounded retries, backoff, circuit breaking and safe handoff. Skill retrieval is not automatically preferable to correct failure handling.
